reason: I already work with the neighborhood broker and he takes nothing until he sells. These people want 50,000 up front or a percentage with no written mandate, just words, and I would not hand a stranger my apartments on that basis. I would also have to ask my brothers and my father first, and they would say no.
objection: The broker gets paid only if he sells, and here they want money in advance. There is no contract, so if the property does not sell I have lost 50,000 and have nothing in writing. A video on an influencer's page does not guarantee a serious buyer.
would_change_my_mind: Pay only on sale, with nothing up front, and a written agreement stating the percentage and the duration, plus proof that he has sold similar properties in El Oued.
